annotations.text: The shipped podium is one card capped at 620pt, sized for a phone and shown at that size on every desktop. Here the ending owns the window: one measure up to 1200pt, type scaled with it, and the same content the card carries today.
Below the rosters the shipped order holds: comms, the actions, then banked and the countdown on the measure's edges. The clock's drain bar runs the full measure in the score bar's own language.
Upright, the sides stack at full width instead of halving the measure, so a name and its figures stop fighting for the same 180 points. Every key is 44pt or taller.
On a phone held sideways the spine becomes a right rail and comms keep one row under the thumbs.
